_comment: Obsah galerie. Přidej položku = jeden objekt. Když 'src' chybí nebo soubor neexistuje, vykreslí se halftone placeholder — mřížka funguje i prázdná. Doporučené fotky: 1600px na delší straně, jpg/webp, do assets/gallery/.

items.title: Night Shift
items.body: Handheld takes from a single night. Shot muted, cut to the sound of the room.

items.title: Snake Height
items.body: Logotype pulled apart until the counters break, then printed badly on purpose.

items.title: Halftone Atlas
items.body: A hundred plates at increasing dot density. The whole point is the moment it stops reading.

items.title: S*burban
items.body: Fashion film shot on the edge of the city, mostly at dusk.

items.title: Legacy Project
items.body: Campaign built entirely from archive material and a scanner.

items.title: Raw Archive
items.body: An index that refuses to explain itself. Scroll is the only interface.

items.title: Contact Sheet 01
items.body: Everything from one roll, nothing removed.

items.title: Register
items.body: Four families forced into one lockup. It should not work.

items.title: Flevopark
items.body: Long lens, no permission, one afternoon.

items.title: Mirror Study
items.body: Silkscreen on mirror. Reads differently depending on who is standing there.

items.title: Compression Test
items.body: The same clip exported twelve times until the artefacts became the subject.

items.title: Invitation
items.body: Risograph, two passes, deliberately out of register.

items.body: Portraits where the face is never the point.

items.title: Ground Floor
items.body: Static camera, ninety minutes, one doorway.
